cover.title: A digital marketplace to secure [Client]'s competitive advantage
cover.subtitle: Draft proposal for [Client], a construction and building materials company

context.title: [Client] wants a digital marketplace, without cannibalizing the core business
bullets: [Client] is a construction and building materials company responding to an internal push into digital.
It wants a new business model centered on a digital marketplace to secure competitive advantage going forward.
The foothold must open new revenue streams and future-proof the business without major cannibalization or short-term loss.
Conditions: scale globally quickly by using existing assets; keep strategic control without losing speed.
[Client] has issued an RFP and has a view on which markets are strategically interesting to it.

market_research.title: Peers and regulators are moving on construction-sector digital

rows.finding: 2026–2029 plan includes acts introducing a digital product passport for construction products.
rows.implication: A marketplace may have to carry product-passport data; confirm whether it is in scope.

rows.finding: Online marketplace sales are a measured but small share of EU enterprise turnover.
rows.implication: Sets a realistic ceiling on near-term marketplace revenue.

rows.finding: Investment in construction technology fell year on year.
rows.implication: Funding conditions for a new digital venture are tightening.

next_steps.title: Proposed next steps
bullets: Confirm engagement scope, length and the stakeholders on both sides.
Develop the detailed phase plan: a Design phase, then a Pilot.
Agree commercial terms and the project team before kickoff.
